datasets.name: d9b56b61
queryLines:
SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.order_timestamp,
    DATE(o.order_timestamp) AS order_date,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_timestamp) AS order_month,
    DATE_FORMAT(o.order_timestamp, 'yyyy-MM') AS order_month_label,

    c.customer_id,
    c.customer_city,
    c.customer_state,

    COALESCE(s.state_name, 'Unknown') AS state_name,
    COALESCE(s.region, 'Unknown') AS region,

    o.product_id,

    COALESCE(
        pc.product_category_name_english,
        p.product_category_name,
        'Unknown'
    ) AS product_category,

    o.quantity,
    o.price,

   
    ROUND(o.price, 2) AS revenue,

   
    CASE 
        WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY o.order_id 
            ORDER BY o.product_id
        ) = 1 
        THEN 1 
        ELSE 0 
    END AS total_orders,

    o.source,
    o.ingestion_timestamp

FROM
    dbr_dev.brazilian_ecommerce_bronze.brz_orders o

LEFT JOIN 
    dbr_dev.brazilian_ecommerce_bronze.brz_customers c
    ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id

LEFT JOIN 
    dbr_dev.brazilian_ecommerce_bronze.dim_brazil_states s
    ON c.customer_state = s.state_code

LEFT JOIN 
    dbr_dev.brazilian_ecommerce_bronze.brz_products p
    ON o.product_id = p.product_id

LEFT JOIN 
    dbr_dev.brazilian_ecommerce_bronze.brz_products_categories pc
    ON p.product_category_name = pc.product_category_name

WHERE
    o.source != 'evh_brazilian_ecommerce';

WITH region_rev AS (

datasets.name: top10_categories_exec
queryLines:
WITH category_agg AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      pc.product_category_name_english,
      p.product_category_name,
      'Unknown'
    ) AS product_category,
    ROUND(SUM(o.price), 2) AS total_revenue,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.product_id) AS num_products
  FROM
    dbr_dev.brazilian_ecommerce_bronze.brz_orders o
      LEFT JOIN dbr_dev.brazilian_ecommerce_bronze.brz_products p
        ON o.product_id = p.product_id
      LEFT JOIN dbr_dev.brazilian_ecommerce_bronze.brz_products_categories pc
        ON p.product_category_name = pc.product_category_name
  WHERE
    o.source != 'evh_brazilian_ecommerce'
  GROUP BY
    COALESCE(pc.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name, 'Unknown')
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(total_revenue) AS total
  FROM
    category_agg
)
SELECT
  product_category,
  total_revenue,
  ROUND(total_revenue / grand_total.total * 100, 2) AS revenue_pct,
  num_products
FROM
  category_agg CROSS JOIN grand_total
ORDER BY
  total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10

queryLines:
WITH original_table AS (
    SELECT 
  DATE_TRUNC("MONTH", `order_month`) AS order_month,
  SUM(`revenue`) AS revenue
FROM (
    SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.order_timestamp,
    DATE(o.order_timestamp) AS order_date,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_timestamp) AS order_month,
    DATE_FORMAT(o.order_timestamp, 'yyyy-MM') AS order_month_label,

    c.customer_id,
    c.customer_city,
    c.customer_state,

    COALESCE(s.state_name, 'Unknown') AS state_name,
    COALESCE(s.region, 'Unknown') AS region,

    o.product_id,

    COALESCE(
        pc.product_category_name_english,
        p.product_category_name,
        'Unknown'
    ) AS product_category,

    o.quantity,
    o.price,
    ROUND(o.price, 2) AS revenue,

    CASE 
        WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY o.order_id 
            ORDER BY o.product_id
        ) = 1 
        THEN 1 
        ELSE 0 
    END AS total_orders,

    o.source,
    o.ingestion_timestamp

FROM
    dbr_dev.brazilian_ecommerce_bronze.brz_orders o

LEFT JOIN 
    dbr_dev.brazilian_ecommerce_bronze.brz_customers c
    ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id

LEFT JOIN 
    dbr_dev.brazilian_ecommerce_bronze.dim_brazil_states s
    ON c.customer_state = s.state_code

LEFT JOIN 
    dbr_dev.brazilian_ecommerce_bronze.brz_products p
    ON o.product_id = p.product_id

LEFT JOIN 
    dbr_dev.brazilian_ecommerce_bronze.brz_products_categories pc
    ON p.product_category_name = pc.product_category_name

WHERE
    o.source != 'evh_brazilian_ecommerce'
) GROUP BY 1
  ),
  dates AS (
    SELECT 
      MAX(order_month) AS max_date_column,
      MIN(order_month) AS min_date_column,
      MAX_BY(revenue, order_month) AS revenue
    FROM original_table
  ),
  forecast_table AS (
    SELECT 
      order_month,
      revenue_forecast,
      revenue_upper,
      revenue_lower,
      NULL AS revenue
    FROM AI_FORECAST(
      TABLE(original_table),
      horizon => (
        SELECT
          max_date_column + MAKE_DT_INTERVAL(CAST(FLOOR(DATEDIFF(max_date_column, min_date_column) * 0.5) AS INT), 0, 0, 0)
        FROM dates
      ),
      time_col => 'order_month',
      value_col => 'revenue'
    )
  )

  SELECT * FROM forecast_table
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    order_month,
    NULL AS revenue_forecast,
    NULL AS revenue_upper,
    NULL AS revenue_lower,
    revenue
  FROM original_table
    WHERE order_month < (SELECT max_date_column FROM dates)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    max_date_column AS order_month,
    revenue AS revenue_forecast,
    revenue AS revenue_upper,
    revenue AS revenue_lower,
    revenue
  FROM
    dates

datasets.name: rt_regional_streaming
queryLines:
WITH region_rev AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(s.region, 'Unknown') AS region,
    ROUND(SUM(o.price), 2) AS region_revenue,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS region_orders
  FROM
    dbr_dev.brazilian_ecommerce_bronze.brz_orders o
      LEFT JOIN dbr_dev.brazilian_ecommerce_bronze.brz_customers c
        ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
      LEFT JOIN dbr_dev.brazilian_ecommerce_bronze.dim_brazil_states s
        ON c.customer_state = s.state_code
  WHERE
    o.source = 'evh_brazilian_ecommerce'
  GROUP BY
    COALESCE(s.region, 'Unknown')
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  s.state_name,
  COALESCE(s.region, 'Unknown') AS region,
  COALESCE(rr.region_revenue, 0) AS region_revenue,
  COALESCE(rr.region_orders, 0) AS region_orders
FROM
  dbr_dev.brazilian_ecommerce_bronze.dim_brazil_states s
    LEFT JOIN region_rev rr
      ON COALESCE(s.region, 'Unknown') = rr.region
WHERE
  s.state_name IS NOT NULL

datasets.name: rt_kpis
queryLines:
WITH latest_date AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(DATE(MAX(order_timestamp)), CURRENT_DATE()) AS max_date
  FROM dbr_dev.brazilian_ecommerce_bronze.brz_orders
  WHERE source = 'evh_brazilian_ecommerce'
)

SELECT
  ld.max_date AS report_date,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders_latest_day,
  ROUND(SUM(o.quantity * o.price), 2) AS revenue_latest_day,
  ROUND(
    SUM(o.quantity * o.price) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0),
    2
  ) AS aov_latest_day,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers_latest_day,
  MAX(o.order_timestamp) AS last_event_received
FROM dbr_dev.brazilian_ecommerce_bronze.brz_orders o
CROSS JOIN latest_date ld
WHERE o.source = 'evh_brazilian_ecommerce'
  AND DATE(o.order_timestamp) = ld.max_date
GROUP BY ld.max_date;

datasets.name: rt_pipeline_status
queryLines:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN MAX(order_timestamp) >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 24 HOURS THEN '🟢 Active'
    ELSE '🔴 Inactive'
  END AS pipeline_status,
  CONCAT(
    'Latest streaming event received: ',
    date_format(MAX(order_timestamp), 'dd MMM yyyy | HH:mm:ss'),
    ' UTC'
  ) AS latest_event_text
FROM
  dbr_dev.brazilian_ecommerce_bronze.brz_orders
WHERE
  source = 'evh_brazilian_ecommerce'
